field.role: Retained field layout, 22 wall bases, three RC crossings and actual external door cuts.

ordinaryWall.role: Proposed bonded mineral DPC and ordinary wall/floor air transition.

ordinaryOuter.role: Ordinary 429.5 mm wall layer order only. The historic local pier, floor and lower cold receiver are excluded.

loggia.role: Earlier located loggia wall-base tray comparison only. Current depths, plan, grid and site comparator come from HAD and STR.

airDuty.role: Single provisional floor/wall aggregate, with disjoint opening and service families.

court.role: Shared conditional court assembly at the opening-family cut.

stack.airLine: Wallmineralplaster meets floorfinish at0; movement/airtightness unqualified
stack.moisture: 40cover suspendedRC is a deliberate moisture hypothesis. NoDPM or site-required gas barrier is waived; exact floor/end/DPC transition not qualified.

actualFloor.structuralPour: Preferred finite construction control: form a continuous upper200mm dry-floor lift (20.98m3 nominal), including the head/beam overlap once and the formed threshold seat. No planned full-depth intermediate joint in occupied field; if the lower grillage is cast first, structural horizontal construction interface is at underside -380 with prepared rough concrete and continuing reinforcement. Starter/interlock, real pour length, temperature/early-age restraint, interruption detail and any service penetrations still need coordinated design. Do not declare the construction joint airtight.
actualFloor.structuralMaterialScope: C30/S500 only structural comparison. Composite RC density at or below25kN/m3 including the actual bars must be delivered for this load bound. Cement dose, constituent mix, permeability, curing, floor surface/air-wall seal and actual site/water exposure remain the material/source owners’ duties. 300kg/m3 or 40mm exposure hypothesis alone gives no admission.

guidance.edition: England AD C, 2004 with 2010/2013 amendments, printed p27 §§4.17–4.20 and §5.5. Accessed 7 November 2026.
guidance.role: Suspended-floor moisture control and separate drainage/ventilation conditions. Site gas, groundwater, actual materials and project applicability remain open.

voidComparison.scope: The D1800 stress check compares vertical reservations. The deeper water track keeps its own location and vent/drainage obligations. Establish the actual underfloor enclosure, opposite openings, free path past every support and screen, ground/drainage relation, water entry and vermin protection before accepting a vent route.

control.role: Two opposed W/E geometric strips under the proposed common grid. The 50% fraction is an authored removable-screen requirement for comparison. No product, formed plinth opening, exposure or every-bay circulation is assumed.

ventSliceTrial.scope: Geometric strips between external W/E mouth reservations. Actual screens, plinth, independent outdoor-deck supports, services, drainage, flood/splash response, effective openings and distribution to every bay remain unqualified. The rear strip traverses the zone below the outdoor loggia. Free areas are screen sensitivities, not flow, compliance or a substitute for effective drainage.

control.role: Authored removable metal screen and hood with continuous cheeks and a free outer drip. All dimensions are clear finished geometry except the named skirt thickness. No proprietary product, weather test or installed plinth is credited.

ventMouthComparison.scope: Clear areas of successive sections only. The smaller area bounds the geometric opening; pressure losses add. Wind-driven water, seams, debris, rebound, plinth support, outlet, service access, adjacent upper-deck supports and every-bay ventilation require separate evidence.

solumFallTrial.scope: An ideal plane is neither a working outlet nor a predicted deformed surface. Independent downhill receiving ground and controlling backwater below the running solum outlet, continuous routes past shafts and plinth, differential heave and erosion remain unverified.

control.role: Geometric air corridor in the open void, with local space to drop and rise on either side of the water track. The westward solum fall is a sensitivity for the pre-site drainage requirement, with no nominated construction or outfall.

ventCrossingPath.scope: Known geometric airspace under the gallery. No liner, duct, air interchange, installed screens, footing, plinth, handling hardware, physical drainage, threshold-seat coverage or verified air delivery to every bay.

trial.role: Two tapered limited-length metal tray wings outboard of the court door aprons. Outlets occupy formed perpendicular joints above the comparison mineral plinth. The high jamb return laps over the wing. Collection at its heel, the lower wet wall, court corners, masonry support and thermal behaviour remain open.

courtWallTray.scope: Two straight wings and the two-level jamb handoff. Full jamb collection, corner ends, below-tray wetting, thermal bridging, supports, masonry set-out and installed performance remain open.

proposedMonolithicCastUnion.scope: Structural candidate union at Z−380..−180. Separate exterior decking and low ties are outside it. Interface edges are potential concrete-face terminations before actual covers, coatings, returns or contacts. They are not measured open paths or another air allocation. Shoulder cage, batch and weight are not inherited from the dry slab.

control.role: Authored absolute-volume comparison for washed mineral aggregate and effective water, without a credited admixture. Densities, void fraction, delivered workability/strength and retained constituents require evidence.

batchComparison.decision: The zero-air comparison exceeds the current structural weight budget. Actual fresh density with the delivered reinforcement must earn the load bound or STR must recheck the actual actions. Entrapped air remains a measured input.

binderEvidence.product: Cemex Portland, Rugby works, CEM I 52.5 N
binderEvidence.role: Issue 13 dated 10 March 2026 identifies Rugby CEM I and its DoP. Manufacturer EPD composition table excludes gypsum and identifies significant heat of hydration. Exact batch, minor additions, processing aids and delivered concrete remain unqualified.

curingAndJoint.candidate: One continuous upper lift after lower grid preparation. Plan temporary formwork removal, batch continuity and water curing with recoverable protection.
releaseDuties: Record actual batch yield, temperature, effective water, consolidation and cover.
Protect exposed concrete promptly against moisture loss, rain washing and temperature extremes. Verify curing and early-age restraint for the actual binder and placement.
Treat a full-depth interruption seam as a new joint with its own load, capillary, water and air route.
Expose and assess the cured slab, wall-base junctions and openings interfaces before covering with glass and the service/finish layers.

ordinaryDpcControl.unitReference: Ketley WCBL65 candidate only; 102/102.5 longitudinal identity remains unresolved, and exact mortar retained constituents/bond/exposure are unqualified
ordinaryDpcControl.role: Full wall-width capillary control. Not an impermeable air/gas sheet and not proof of joint performance. Existing top bed belongs to the wall above.

ordinaryAirRoute.name: Concrete body -> complete bottom bed -> bonded DPC body/perpends/upper bed -> wall core below plaster stop -> plaster
rules: First compare the actual bonded mineral assembly as a complete air transition; neither brick absorption nor mortar designation demonstrates its leakage
Include the 30 mm wall-core height above DPC and below plaster stop; do not jump from DPC top -30 to plaster at0
Do not plaster continuously down to wet RC and around the DPC; do not close an air drawing by creating a damp bypass
Concrete moisture resistance, air permeability, crack/joint leakage and gas suitability remain separate duties
Do not assume a new metal return is needed or qualified; if used it needs actual cast-in depth, cage/compaction, weld, movement and plaster-interface evidence

existingLoggiaTrayComparison.status: Custom formed metal tray/embedded return requires qualification; no225mm clear cavity claimed.

capillaryPaths: Ground and wet supports can feed the connected lower RC and slab. Establish matrix and interface transfer under the actual exposure.
Outdoor RC and threshold seat contacts remain possible bypasses. Close the actual external and internal DPC ends, including the local structural pier cuts.
Each vertical RC core and the stair toe has a separate moisture and surface duty. The slab comparison does not qualify those vertical paths.
airAndCapillaryRegister.airTestScope: One aggregate for slab body, actual cracks and joints, ordinary wall bases, three structural crossings and the stair toe up to the actual assembly cuts. Opening and service assemblies retain their own disjoint budgets. Mask those interfaces when isolating this family and verify the final whole envelope unmasked. Every installed contribution remains unmeasured.

idealCrackModel.role: Ideal full-depth uniform smooth slit sensitivity with no slip, laminar fully developed flow. Actual through-crack length, aperture profile, contact, entry/end effects, site gas and installed air/moisture are unmeasured.

costScope.role: The RC lift and cage are shared structural work. Compare actual mix, cure, inspection, interface and renewal differences before drawing a cost conclusion.
